qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the cap nut on the air intake tube?
What type designation is specified for the compression screw in the air pump system?
Which components in section 1172 have the same torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The compression screw and lock nut both have a torque specification of 5 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What system do the components listed under section 1172 belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Air pump, lines and control valves

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque specifications are listed for the air pump system components?
qa_pairs.answer: Two different torque specifications: 30 Nm for the cap nut and 5 Nm for both the compression screw and lock nut

qa_pairs.question: What part number designation applies to all three components listed?
Which component has the highest torque specification in the air pump system?
qa_pairs.answer: The cap nut on air intake tube has the highest torque specification at 30 Nm
